summary: perf(settings): load Settings and CAD Glean events lazily
description:
Because:

- Every route bundled the Settings, CAD and DTM Glean metric modules.
- The pairing hand-off navigates right after its events, so those events
  cannot wait on a chunk fetch.

This commit:

- Moves 87 recordEventMetric cases to lib/glean/lazy-events.ts.
- Loads lazy-events with a dynamic import in the glean-lazy-events chunk.
- Keeps the dtmMobile and download Firefox view events eager.
- Awaits recordEventMetric in the queued lambda to keep the call order.
- Adds a table test for the events and a call order test.

Closes FXA-14859
